note: Friend holds the connection (a ping inside the window, an outage said once), the session challenge (a ping past the window dropped and never answered, any line the session writes after a ping ending the challenge and proving the push, nothing delivered until the session is proven), the batch delivery's turns (a note handed, deferred or given up after its bound) and the one-shot lanes (a card's turn needs the session proven and unbroken but not the harness up, a harness fault keeps the card counted toward nothing, a card at its cap set aside after one turn), with the reversed witnesses noproof, deliverlimited, asideearly and faultcounts. A change of mode, the pacing's deferral of a batch turn, the lane sessions' opening and the reads are below the module's grain.

FriendStage holds the daemon's staging of the jobs it writes: a stage begun only for a written brief, a lane handed a card only once its JOB.md is there, one judgment per unreachable repository or missing base while it stands, a stop that says nothing, and a failed job staged again once its remedy lands, with three reversed witnesses. The mirror's freshness window, the per-repository lock and the checkout's move-in are below the module's grain; a read's checkout is not staged and is not in it.

Bus2 holds a send to every recipient and the log in one step (to and cc folded into one set), pending until ack, a live reader keeping its message while held under ClaimAfter, and a Stall that makes a holder idle past ClaimAfter claimable by any reader, with six reversed witnesses (partial, newfirst, steal, claimfresh, ackundelivered, ackreopens). bus.go cites those properties. A message's kind and RecvKinds, which releases a skipped kind at once, are not states in the module.
A member's presence on the fleet table, and the swarm's lease on a slot, have no module. A member's presence on the fleet table moved with internal/sprint to mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint in v1.2.3.

The merge queue, a card's promotion into it, and the member's tree have no module. Land models only the batch pushed from the queue. The two-level landing module CardISA cites is not in this tree. The merge queue and promotion moved with internal/sprint and cmd/nova-sprint to mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint in v1.2.3; the member's tree stays here.
No module, and no Go file in this tree, is an install that rolls back when ticks are missed. seat install (nova-sprint, now in mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint) is a different verb and is not this machine.

UpdateApply holds one run of the version inventory, the state file, and a delivery recorded only after the bus says SEND OK, with three reversed witnesses. The code delivers by nova-bus send. The older join path is gone; the module already names the bus only as that SEND OK.

CairnStore holds the session, the append, the log, the index and the coverage counts with no gap ledger, a re-open that names another publish policy refused, and a crash in Open healed by logging the open record, with three reversed witnesses (an overwrite, a report before fsync, a re-open with another policy). cairn.go writes an entry atomically, does not report before that write, implements no transport, and heals an interrupted open by logging the open record.

The table layer is the modelled layer (tla/README.md): contracts, member and epoch placement, edits, order, the shell, the function libraries, first contact and the fuse box. Each module has an expected-fail witness. TableMachine models the pinned baseline internal/tablemodel/testdata/table-pinned.lua, not today's pkg/nsprint/fn/lua/table.lua, and RedisFn names that witness without the word Broken in the configuration file; the plan's expected column is not pass.

CardContract holds the finish of a card, the member's push and the one judgment, with ten reversed witnesses. The sprint's side (a redeal, the retire at the redeal bound, a restage, the staging bound and the level) moved to nova-sprint in v1.2.3 and is outside the module. A finish or push file that is not a regular file is no record, the same absent record the module already finishes from, not a new state.

BenchRun holds one nova-ci bench run: the hosts in order, the make, copy, exec and remove steps on the first host that answers, and an interrupt that may land at any step, with an exec interrupt that kills the command (ranCmd, exit Killed) held by InterruptedExecRan, and two reversed witnesses (a failed copy that skips the deferred remove, an exec interrupt that refuses a run whose command ran). Every host's answer and every step's outcome is chosen by TLC, so the model covers each order of failure the code can meet.

BenchStage holds one bench's stage: the seed, the send measured from bytes, verification of the whole set before the first rename, a binary skipped when it already holds the release bytes, and a crash anywhere, with one reversed witness. The later stage-then-rename in install.go is that verify-before-rename.

ConfigApply holds a store write and its history row, the per-kind revision, Redis as a copy, the stamp after the ops, and machine before friend, with four reversed witnesses. It was written from this code. Friend slots, tiers and the bench registry set are outside the instance, which says field checks beyond the ref are.
A secret's placement, its sealing, and the seat's key have no module.
A decision's record, and the decision of one attempt, have no module.
FileLock holds the lock file's take and a stale holder, with four reversed witnesses. filelock.go cites the module. The only change since the module is the wording of the package comment.

Bus2Receipts (EXTENDS Bus2) holds the receipt states (delivered, read, acted) over the delivery machine, moved only by the Forward rule, and the daemon's idempotent take, turn, ack, a lost ack and a crash, with ReceiptNeverMovesBack, ActedImpliesDelivered and NoIdActedTwice and two reversed witnesses (a take that pushes a redelivered id, a recv that writes delivered over the receipt). The model reads the receipt at the take; the code reads it at the recv (Entry.Stage). A refused acted stamp is not modelled.

FriendEnvelope holds the full available pending set, the adapter text cap, the MaxBatch read cap while a present is owed, an exit-0 ack that is its own step and can fail, a failed message given up and acked once it reaches MaxDeliveries, accepted- and given-up-envelope acknowledgments, claim reopening and eventual delivery. EnvelopeTakesAll, NoYoungerFirst, AckOnlyAccepted and GivenUpOnlyAtTheBound hold with three reversed witnesses (newest-first, one-per-turn, give-up-early); the failure-reorder witness documents that a held failed message can be acknowledged after a younger one. Metadata, authority labels and proof-id lifetime are below this model grain.

Caller-owned byte cursor over complete append-only records; bus return and process restart retain unread records; file replacement and truncation refuse. Broken EOF rearm skips an undelivered record. Prefix hash validation is the byte-level implementation fence, not an LLM receipt.

FriendLane holds a friend's lanes as thin clients of the sprint server, which keeps one record per (friend, lane, epoch): a lane asks what it holds (take --lane, its row and its lane and nothing else), runs exactly what the answer names, reports by the server's ids, epoch and lane, and drops the job on any refusal; a restarted lane asks first; a lane unheard past the bound is gone and its card bounces back; a clear is a new epoch. A work card runs with no begin (a read keeps its begin), and a row read that disagrees drops the card locally and the lane asks again. Invariants WorkingOnlyOnTheServersSay, OneRequestApart and NoStaleStep, liveness WorkingResolves and AllDone, with seven reversed witnesses (a took on an answer that named no card, progress at the directory's epoch twice over, a lane that runs on after a refusal, a server that checks the card alone, a server with no gone bound, a lane that keeps running after a row read disagrees). The finish of a card held with a run's report before (TakenFinish) is modelled. Below the module's grain: the ask pacing, the brief and stage waits, the adoption of a working card no lane holds (a TakeGrant of a card the server already has working), her finish's next card, the clearing of a lane's hold by any other move (a Gone-like drop of the record), the read lanes' leases, Return as the stop-return (named by lane, as Owns), and Card.Epoch's directory-epoch fallback for a card the server named none for (the LocalEpoch witness's live behaviour).
one receiver, durable ready intent, accepted before ack; deal withdrawal, coalescing and the wake ping are outside; the capacity is the Codex queue's
--from, a skipped push, an early proof and the refused window are outside

LoopRedial holds the reader's connection to the sprint server: a restart drops the connection and the reader notices on the next verb's error, backs off one second doubling to MaxBackoff and re-dials on a fresh connection, so it never parks on a dropped connection (NoParkOnDropped) and beats again (BeatsAgain), with the wait bounded (BackoffBounded) and two reversed witnesses (noredial, nobound). The bytes of the wire, the asks themselves and the server's own state beyond the connections it holds are below the module's grain (sprintredial_test.go).
one message per token within its life, the original answered; no instance and no case, so TLC never checks it

Delivery holds the present: a session start and a gap after Stale owe it, one turn carries the newest note from the seat (nothing while the seat is unknown), a one-shot present supersedes the note and delivers no turn, a present whose turn fails is owed again after a beat carrying the same note, fresh pings are answered and everything else superseded. GapCarriesThePresent, NoSupersededDelivered, NoStaleNonceAnswered and NoteFromSeat hold with four reversed witnesses (nopresent, reclaim, answerstale, anysender). The acted receipt, the one-shot lanes and the bus-log status line are below this model grain.
the session check is here; the table's word, the deal and the take moved to nova-sprint; any session bus line and a finish count as evidence

a lane takes a card and holds it before it launches, and on STOP every running lane and every read is cancelled and owed a stop-return, a held card given up with its return owed, and every owed return sent whatever the word, with the heldthrough reversed witness; a batch turn already running goes on (a dealt-card turn started by startDealt, daemon.go), a v1.2.14 candidate
